scope: Enterprise:Enterprise official demo storefront inspected with read-only rendered browser accessibility trees; no shopper actions, screenshot, viewport measurement, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Enterprise preset listing View demo opened a storefront labelled Enterprise Theme Enterprise.

claims.observed: Smart Tech category structure presents technical filters with sort and compare affordances; the camera PDP displays technical specifications and product details.
claims.risk: Browser-rendered control presence does not establish working interactions or consistent comparison behavior.
claims.vsn_guard: Implement only after interaction and cross-page field consistency are verified; keep observed structure separate from functional claims.

claims.observed: Pages display sample pricing, review counts, inventory, shipping, discount and promotion claims.
claims.risk: These are merchant statements in a sample store and were not independently validated.
claims.vsn_guard: Require merchant evidence, market scope and current policy before using trust or inventory claims.
